points: Applies to anyone who left voluntarily with a completed notice period.
A minimum of six months must have passed since the last working day.
The previous line manager must raise no objection in writing.
Final performance rating must have been Meets Expectations or above.
Rehired employees restart probation but keep their original seniority date for leave.
policies.summary: Left Med Right on good terms and want to come back? Five conditions, one no-objection confirmation, and a clear decision.
policies.title: Employee Rehire Policy

sections.heading: Purpose and scope
sections.body: This policy sets out when a former employee may be considered for re-employment at Med Right, and who decides. It covers all permanent and fixed-term roles across Egypt.
items: Applies to voluntary resignations and end of fixed-term contracts.
Does not apply where employment ended through disciplinary dismissal.

sections.body: All five conditions below must be satisfied before an application is progressed to interview. People & Organisation confirms each one against the employee file.
items: Notice period served in full, with clearance completed.
At least six months since the last working day.
No live disciplinary sanction at the point of leaving.
Final performance rating of Meets Expectations or above.
Written no-objection from the former line manager or their successor.
sections.heading: Eligibility conditions

sections.body: Apply through the normal vacancy process and declare your previous employment on the application. The recruiter flags the file to People & Organisation, who complete the rehire check before any interview is scheduled.
sections.heading: How to apply

sections.body: A rehired employee joins on the terms of the role being filled, not the terms they left on. Probation restarts in full.
items: Salary is set by the grade of the new role and current pay bands.
Annual leave entitlement recognises the original joining date.
Medical insurance restarts from the new joining date.
sections.heading: Terms on return
Decision and records
sections.body: The hiring manager, with People & Organisation, makes the final decision. Where a condition is not met, an exception may be approved only by the Managing Director in writing, and the reason is recorded on file.

sections.heading: The awards
sections.body: Recognition runs on a quarterly cycle with an annual close.
items: Above and Beyond — effort clearly outside the day job.
Member First — a decision that put a member or client first.
Better Every Day — an improvement that saved time, cost or error.
Grand Award — chosen annually from the twelve quarterly winners.

sections.body: Any employee may nominate any colleague other than themselves, at any point in the quarter. Managers may nominate their own team members. A nomination needs one specific example, not a general endorsement.
sections.heading: Who can nominate

sections.body: The recognition committee — two People & Organisation representatives and three rotating department nominees — scores each nomination on impact, evidence and alignment to values.
sections.heading: How winners are chosen
items: Nominations close on the fifteenth of the month following quarter end.
Committee meets within two weeks of close.
Winners announced at the monthly all-hands and on the hub.

sections.body: Each quarterly winner receives 5,000 EGP paid with the following month's salary, a signed certificate, and a note on their personnel file. The grand award winner receives a further 5,000 EGP.
sections.heading: The award

policies.title: Reward & Recognition Policy
policies.summary: Great work should not go unseen. Three quarterly awards, one annual grand award, a transparent process, and 5,000 EGP for every winner.
points: Three awards each quarter, nominated by any colleague.
One annual grand award chosen from the quarterly winners.
Every winner receives 5,000 EGP plus a certificate.
The recognition committee reviews all nominations within two weeks of quarter close.

POLICY V1 · AUGUST 2026
People & Organization

Employee Rehire Policy

Left well and want to come back? Ten short chapters: five conditions, one no-objection confirmation, and a decision you can see coming.

Check my eligibility
Navigator · your guide
01 Why 02 Who 03 Journey 04 Conditions 05 No-objection 06 Who does what 07 Records 08 Fairness 09 Forms 10 Glossary
01

Why this policy exists

This policy sets out the framework for rehiring former full-time employees who left through voluntary resignation. It establishes the eligibility conditions that must be satisfied, defines the rehire process — same role or a different one — and specifies the approvals required before any offer is made.

The Organization values the knowledge, skills and cultural contribution of former employees. Where every condition is met and a genuine business need exists, we are open to your return.
02

Who it covers

Applies to you if
  • You were a full-time employee and left through voluntary resignation
  • You completed all contractual obligations — notice period and handover
  • You are applying to your previous role, or to a different department and/or role
Does not apply if
  • You were dismissed for misconduct
  • You left during your probationary period
  • You were a contractor, part-time or temporary staff — separate frameworks apply
  • You resigned with immediate effect without completing notice
03

From last day to decision

Six milestones with fixed time boundaries. Nothing moves earlier except by a documented, CEO-approved waiver of the cooling-off period.

1
Day 0
Last working day
Notice served in full, handover signed off, all assets returned.
2
Months 1–6
Cooling-off period
Six calendar months must pass. Earlier applications are not accepted.
3
Month 6+
Application submitted
Complete and truthful, for the previous role or a different one.
4
5 working days
No-Objection request
P&O writes to the Previous Manager, who responds in writing within five days.
5
Verification
Eligibility check
P&O verifies all five conditions; the Hiring Manager interviews.
6
Decision
Approve or reject
P&O Senior Manager decides; the outcome is confirmed in writing either way.
04

The five conditions

Sentinel
“All five are mandatory. P&O verifies each one against your personnel record before anything moves — there is no version of this where four out of five is enough.”
{{ c.tick }}
CONDITION {{ c.n }}
{{ c.title }}
{{ c.body }}
Ineligible: {{ c.bad }}
{{ gateLabel }}
One exception exists. For a critical skills shortage or a unique operational need, the P&O Head may waive the cooling-off period. The waiver must be documented in writing and approved by the CEO.
05

Previous Manager No-Objection

Beacon
“Your old manager gets asked. Always — same department or not. They know how you worked and how you left, and that view is part of the decision.”
How it's requested
P&O contacts the Previous Manager formally in writing, using the No-Objection Request template on the HR system.
Five working days
Responses come through the official HR system or in writing. Verbal responses are not accepted.
If they object
Reasons must be given in writing. HR reviews, consults Legal/Compliance as needed, and decides whether to proceed.
If they've left too
Confirmation is sought from the next level of management or the relevant department head.
The Previous Manager's response is confidential and is never shared with the former employee.
06

Who does what

Spark
“Six people touch a rehire. Here's who does what — so nobody waits on the wrong desk.”
{{ r.party }} {{ r.count }}
  • {{ i.text }}
    •
07

Confidentiality & records

Everything gathered during a rehire process is strictly confidential and handled in line with Organization policy and applicable law.

The No-Objection Confirmation, or objection, is never disclosed to the former employee.
Personnel file information from the eligibility check is not shared with the Hiring Manager without P&O authorization.
3 yearsminimum retention for every rehire application record — successful or not.
Unsuccessful applications are stored securely on the HR system and the outcome is confirmed in writing, per the Recruitment Policy.
08

Fairness & consequences

Equality & non-discrimination
Rehire decisions are made on objective eligibility criteria and business need. No former employee will be treated less favourably on the grounds of age, sex, gender, marital status, nationality, religion, disability, or any other protected characteristic.
Non-compliance & breach
False or misleading information — including misrepresenting eligibility — means the application is immediately withdrawn. If discovered after an offer is made or accepted, the offer or employment may be terminated in accordance with the employment contract.
09

The two forms

Form 01
Rehire Eligibility Checklist
HR use only — the five conditions, verified and signed off.
Form 02
No-Objection Request Template
Sent by P&O to the Previous Manager. Five working days to respond.
10

The words that matter
